lines.hook: This guy is about to jump into a hole that goes straight to the center of the Earth.
lines.goal: That's almost four thousand miles. Let's see if he makes it.
lines.subway: Three hundred feet. The deepest subway station in the world.
lines.cave: Seven thousand feet. The deepest cave anyone has ever explored.
lines.mine: Two and a half miles. The deepest mine on Earth, where the rock is a hundred and fifty degrees.
lines.kola: Seven and a half miles. The deepest hole humans have ever dug. And he's only point two percent of the way.
lines.moho: Twenty-two miles. He just broke through the crust.
lines.diamonds: A hundred miles. This is where diamonds are made.
lines.core: Eighteen hundred miles. Almost halfway, and it's an ocean of liquid iron.
lines.inner: The inner core. As hot as the surface of the Sun.
lines.center: And he made it. The center of the Earth. Twenty-two thousand miles an hour, and he weighs nothing.
lines.tail: But he can't stop. He shoots straight out the other side, then falls back. Forever.
